about.en: SPYon is the Ondo tokenized ETF for the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by SPY shares and is a total-return tracker: distributions are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above SPY's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xFeDC5f4a6c38211c1338aa411018DFAf26612c08, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the fund.
